response.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, x.`aCL IgM` AS v FROM Examination x JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = x.ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(v) AS m FROM e), d AS (SELECT e.ID, e.SEX, e.v, e.v - o.m AS dev FROM e, o), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(dev) AS avg_dev FROM d GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.v AS `aCL IgM`, d.dev AS deviation, d.dev - s.avg_dev AS excess FROM d JOIN s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.dev > s.avg_dev ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
